decisions.reason: The candidate already has same-message DEFER and MODIFY Events that capture the delayed post-launch wallet-provisioning scope.
The existing message-225 MODIFY already adds POST_LAUNCH to the Transak fiat-mint scope, while the prior DEFER remains in effect.
Delaying Transak availability does not change the primary-sale allocation amounts, recipients, or fiat-fee treatment.
The source changes launch timing for Transak, not the $15 primary-mint price or advertised pricing commitment.
The source does not direct removal, deferral, or revision of the conditional FAQ content describing the fiat-buyer flow.
The unlimited NFT ebook mint remains valid for crypto users and is not changed by postponing the fiat payment path.
The source does not change whether tipping is available or any tipping-page behavior.
The source only postpones Transak availability and does not require a change to the supplied About-page content state.
The Mission-page copy and prize descriptions are independent of Transak's day-one availability.
Proceeding initially with crypto users leaves the existing SIWE requirement for crypto mint and transfer flows unchanged.
Postponing Transak does not alter the Small Block prize amount, trigger, ticket rules, funding, or winner selection.
The referral-code identity and display rules remain valid; fiat-specific email display applies when the postponed fiat flow becomes available.
